profile_text.body:
Amazon is a for-profit public company founded in 1994 and headquartered in Seattle, Washington, United States. Its website is amazon.com. The text harvested from that site contained no substantive description of the business, so no product or positioning claims from the company itself can be reported here.

No products are tracked for Amazon. Four MCP servers are listed in connection with it, all named under non-Amazon domains: ai.sellermate/amazon-ads, described as asking an Amazon Ads account anything and acting with guardrails over a remote MCP connection with OAuth, free to connect; ai.trendsapi/amazon, described as Amazon product search volume and best-seller trends; ai.trendsmcp/amazon, described as Amazon product search demand over time with growth for any keyword; and app.apiguru/amazon-data, described as live Amazon product, review, search, deal, offer and stock, and seller data across 20 marketplaces.

The litigation record lists one case, Haugland v. Anthropic PBC, in the District Court, D. Delaware. Washington is listed as a law exposure jurisdiction with a count of 111.
